attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
  AND s.kind = 'function'
  AND s.name LIKE '%test_redirects%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.imports i
    WHERE i.file_id = s.file_id
      AND i.imported_file_id LIKE '%httpx%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
      AND c.callee_symbol_id IN (
        SELECT symbol_id
        FROM code.symbols
        WHERE name = 'redirects'
          AND file_id IN (
            SELECT file_id
            FROM code.files
            WHERE file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
          )
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.imports i2
    WHERE i2.file_id = s.file_id
      AND i2.module_name = 'httpx'
  )
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
